reviewer: current assistant; no independent human or model validation

labels.D: Direct: asks for the target fact, relation, decision, or translation.
labels.P: Prerequisite: asks for a specific fact or rule with an identifiable role in answering the query. This includes facts needed to evaluate any supplied multiple-choice option.
labels.O: Off-target: no identifiable contribution to the query or its necessary prerequisites; shared patient/paper/topic alone is insufficient.
labels.U: Unclear: relevance cannot be established or rejected from these two questions.

mtob_rule: A word/root in the requested sentence or a construction instantiated in that sentence can be a prerequisite. General grammar with no demonstrated connection is unclear or off-target.
primary_metric: Number labeled O / all sampled questions, with U reported separately.
limits: Relevance does not establish answer correctness, evidence support, multi-hop necessity, or final accuracy.
Original review omitted explicit method labels, but writing style could reveal them; the agnostic extension was not blinded. The assistant knew the research hypothesis throughout.
Evidence-only generation is conditioned on retrieved evidence but not explicitly on q; this does not isolate the pseudo-answer stage from query conditioning.
Only 3 of the first 15 questions per arm and request are sampled.
Shared query/source documents induce dependence between questions.
No ambiguity is automatically counted as off-target.
pre_annotation_amendment: Included original multiple-choice options before any labels were assigned. Sample IDs/indices unchanged; options have no gold-answer marker.
mtob_pre_annotation_amendment: Before any MTOB annotations, include its official English reference translation to interpret the Kalamang query. This is evaluation-only, shared between arms; never use generated pseudo-answers as references.
extension: Add agnostic arm using the same 100 requests, 3 positions per request, unchanged prior labels. No generated data added.
new_annotations_reviewed_by: current assistant, method known; no independent human validation

review_inputs_by_phase.existing_evidence_only_and_specific: Original 600 labels kept unchanged; method label omitted from presented items, style could reveal it.
review_inputs_by_phase.new_agnostic: 300 questions at the same sampled positions; the assistant knew the method. Not independently validated.
